main.title: Set up Speaker Recognition
main.description: Connect Home Assistant to the local Speaker Recognition app. You can enroll a voice next.

enrollment_menu.title: Enroll a speaker
enrollment_menu.description: Guided enrollment builds a stronger reference from several recordings.

enrollment_user.title: Choose a Home Assistant user
enrollment_user.description: New samples rebuild only this user's voiceprint. Other enrolled users are preserved.

enrollment_sample.title: Voice sample {sample_number} of {sample_total}
enrollment_sample.description:
Read this naturally: “{phrase}”

Record audio using a device or the Home Assistant companion app, then upload or select the WAV file from Home Assistant media. {accepted} samples have been accepted.

data_description.finish_enrollment: At least five samples are enough; leave off to record the final suggested phrase.

enrollment_review.title: Review voice samples
enrollment_review.description: {accepted} valid samples are ready. Finish to build the reference voiceprint, or replace any individual recording.

enrollment_complete.title: Enrollment ready
enrollment_complete.description: {accepted} samples were accepted. Submit to save them and build the user's normalized reference voiceprint.

add_stt.title: Set up STT proxy
add_stt.description: Select the STT provider to augment with speaker recognition. Basic DSP is optional and affects only the audio sent to speech-to-text; speaker and whisper recognition continue to use the original audio.

data_description.use_basic_dsp: Apply conservative streaming cleanup for hum and low-level background noise. Off by default because filtering can occasionally reduce speech detail.

add_conversation.title: Set up Conversation proxy
add_conversation.description: Configure the conversation agent and minimum confidence threshold.

error.not_stt_entity: The selected entity is not a speech-to-text entity
error.not_conversation_entity: The selected entity is not a conversation agent
error.speaker_recognition_proxy_source: Select the original provider, not another Speaker Recognition proxy
error.proxy_source_already_wrapped: That provider is already wrapped by another Speaker Recognition proxy
error.invalid_enrollment_sample: Select a local, uncompressed 16-bit PCM WAV recording containing at least 0.5 seconds of audio
